candidates.why: case 90 (12335-12336) overwrites dwg->thumbnail.chain with a fresh calloc without freeing the previous buffer. If a second 90 pair arrives (or chain was already populated), the old buffer is leaked and any pointer derived from it (e.g. s at 12352 in a prior 310 iteration) becomes stale. The overwrite at 12336 is the effective 'release' of the old chain; the subsequent use at 12352 dereferences the (possibly stale/NULL) chain.

s = &dwg->thumbnail.chain[written] is computed at 12352 BEFORE the bounds check at 12353 and without verifying chain is non-NULL. If no 90 pair was seen (chain still NULL) or a prior 90's calloc was overwritten, this dereferences an invalid/freed pointer. The check at 12353 comes too late to protect the pointer arithmetic at 12352.
